### Device and software
Model/board, MainFrameOS build, kernel, firmware/runtime versions. Omit serials.

### Reproduction
Steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, frequency.

### Regression
Last known-good build and first failing build, if known.

### Evidence
Focused, redacted logs and completed workflow checks. Never paste credentials or raw personal logs.
